setup: An 8×8 board (64 squares); columns labelled a–h left to right, rows 1–8 top to bottom. 64 discs, each black on one face and white on the other. Initial position: White discs on d4 and e5; Black discs on e4 and d5. One player is Black, the other White. Black always moves first.
turn_structure: Players alternate turns, making one move per turn, starting with Black. If a player has no legal move, their turn is forfeited (passed) and the opponent moves again; a player may not pass voluntarily if a legal move exists. The game ends when neither player can make a legal move.

actions.name: place_disc
actions.preconditions: It is the player's turn; the chosen square is empty; and placing a disc of the player's colour there outflanks (brackets) at least one unbroken row of one or more opposing discs — i.e., in at least one of the eight directions (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal), the adjacent square holds an opposing disc and continuing in that direction reaches a disc of the player's own colour with only opposing discs in between and no empty square.
actions.effects: A disc of the player's colour is placed on the chosen empty square. Every opposing disc lying in an unbroken bracketed row between the placed disc and a same-colour disc, in every applicable direction, is flipped to the player's colour. Only discs directly bracketed by this move are flipped; discs outflanked 'in passing' as a side effect of other flips are not flipped. Turn then passes to the opponent (unless the opponent must pass).

actions.name: pass
actions.preconditions: The player has no legal place_disc move available (no empty square would flip at least one opposing disc).
actions.effects: The player's turn is forfeited and passes to the opponent, who moves again. No discs are placed or flipped.

objective: The game ends when neither player can make a legal move (most commonly when all 64 squares are filled, but possibly earlier). Discs of each colour are counted; the player with the majority of discs showing their colour wins. Equal counts result in a draw. The winner's score is customarily recorded as their disc count, with empty squares awarded to the winner for tournament scoring.
edge_cases: A player who cannot move must pass, and the opponent moves again; passing is forbidden if any legal move exists.
Discs outflanked 'in passing' (a row bracketed only as a side effect of flips elsewhere) are not flipped.
A move that flips no opposing disc is illegal; discs cannot be placed on occupied squares.
The game can end before the board is full if neither player can flip any disc.
A player may end with zero discs on the board, in which case that player loses.
Corner squares, once taken, can never be flipped.
Equal disc counts result in a draw.
